name: Ardales (Spain)
description: White field with green diagonal stripes at the upper hoist and lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ardales (a castle on blue between olive and almond branches).
history: Municipal flag of Ardales; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
